useCase: Detección de contenido de modelos de IA de difusión modernos como Stable Diffusion, DALL-E y Midjourney.
mechanism:
The detección methodology:

1. **High-frequency residual extraction**: Extrae high-frequency residuals correlating with the iterative denoising process.

2. **Spatial autocorrelación**: Diffusion models operate in compressed latent space, creating characteristic spatial correlación patrones when decoded to pixel space.

3. **Denoising artefacto detección**: Step-by-step denoising leaves subtle but detectable traces, particularly in smooth gradiente regions.

4. **Cross-attention patrones**: Text-to-image diffusion models use cross-attention mechanisms creating detectable spatial coherencia patrones.
accuracy: Alta - 86-94%. Effectiveness varies by model version and generation parameters.
name: Firma de Difusión Algorítmica
parameters:
Analysis window: 64x64, Noise extraction: Wiener filter
Spatial correlación: autocorrelación maps
Target models: Stable Diffusion 1.5/2.1/XL, DALL-E 2/3, Midjourney v4/v5/v6
description: Detecta artefactos specific to diffusion-based AI models (Stable Diffusion, DALL-E, Midjourney) mediante el análisis de denoising step residuals and latent space patrones unique to the iterative denoising generation process.

references.title: Corvi, R. et al. (2023). On the Detection of Synthetic Images Generated by Diffusion Models. ICASSP.
Ricker, J. et al. (2022). Towards the Detection of Diffusion Model Deepfakes.
Sha, Z. et al. (2023). DE-FAKE: Detection and Attribution. ACM CCS.
Wang, Z. et al. (2023). DIRE for Diffusion-Generated Image Detection. ICCV.

strengths:
• Specifically designed for modern diffusion models
• Detecta even high-quality diffusion outputs
• Works a través de different diffusion architectures
• Effective with both text-to-image and image-to-image
limitations:
• Rapid model evolution requires frequent updates
• Img2img with high denoising strength is harder para detectar
• Very small generated regions may evade detección
• Model fine-tuning can alter detectable patrones
